correctness.rationale: The four-subsequence dynamic recurrence counts all 16 patterns exactly and the independent direct four-index combination algorithm agrees at the explicit 14-bit witnesses. Independently enumerated every 2^13=8192 and 2^14=16384 binary word, obtaining respectively 8176 and 16328 exact integer four-deck fibers; no mixed R<=2 vs R>2 group at n=13, exactly one mixed group at n=14: x=01111100111110 (two 1-runs) and y=10101111110101 (five). Each has the displayed common 16-vector summing to C(14,4)=1001. Four-deck equality implies three-deck equality by the exact double-counting (n-3) formula, and leading-zero padding preserves four-deck equality and one-run categories; thus no shorter n>=4 collision, and collisions at every n>=14. Angal et al. Thm 1.3 proves the separate r(B2)<=5 upper bound; the new witness proves lower bound. Verified full enumerators from actual package; complete finite enumeration here is exhaustive for 13,14 only, not for all lengths.
